description: This map displays a false-colour infrared aerial or satellite image of an agricultural landscape. A prominent blue polygonal line delineates a large, irregularly shaped area identified as olive groves. Within this blue boundary, numerous rectangular and irregular patches of intense red colour represent densely planted vegetation, arranged in grid-like patterns characteristic of orchards. These red areas are consistent with actively vegetated olive trees in false-colour infrared imagery. Surrounding the delineated olive groves are fields exhibiting varied colours, including light brown, dark brown, and lighter green, indicating other agricultural land uses such as arable land or bare soil. To the far left, a distinct large area of very dark red suggests another zone of dense vegetation or a different crop type with high infrared reflectance. No scale bar, compass, legend, data source, or specific geographic location or date are visible in the image.
